notes: Bounded smoke uses one curated PMXT event/token selected from G001 inventory; it does not scan the 441-event universe.
No factors, outcomes, strategies, fills, positions, cash, fees, PnL, or performance conclusions are computed.
PMXT adapter sorted by timestamp, timestamp_received, then original row index.
Stable fallback is deterministic but not proof of true exchange/message order.
Tied timestamp groups with differing row content require sensitivity testing.

ts_init_audit.note: Events sharing a replay-clock timestamp are serialized by +1ns increments so Nautilus ts_init stays strictly increasing; the strategy observes these events sequentially even though the source clock cannot distinguish their order.
